replies.text:
Hi Casey, thanks for asking about Lot 2-3 at Juniper Bench.

Lot 2-3 is on hold right now, so it isn't available to buy at the moment. It's a land-only lot of 0.174 acres, listed at $109,000.

A few similar land-only lots are available. Lot 2-4 is 0.174 acres at $110,500. Lot 2-12 is 0.173 acres at $109,000. You can see Lot 2-4 here: http://localhost:3300/juniper-bench/lots/2-4

What matters most to you in a lot, such as size, location in the neighborhood, or price? That will help me point you to the right one.
